business.description: Munjal Auto Industries Limited operates five manufacturing plants located at Waghodia and Sanand in Gujarat, Bawal and Dharuhera in Haryana, and Haridwar in Uttarakhand. The company focuses on optimizing investments and ensuring business continuity to enhance market share across various platforms.

outlook.statement: The Company is targeting a step-up in both top-line and bottom-line performance over the coming years.
OEM relationships have expanded from two to four, with a long-term supply contract secured with Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India and deeper engagement with Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles.
Indutch Composites Technology Private Limited expects ~20% revenue growth next year.
Consumer spending is projected to reach Rs 31,153 billion by 2027 and Rs 33,178 billion by 2028, giving Munjal Auto a durable tailwind.
